core_obligations: Retain grading, wrapped/compact/Rabinowitz category setup and compact-support triviality.
Construct the map modulo the braid center using the stability/auto-equivalence identification.
Use the cluster exchange graph comparison to eliminate the cyclic obstruction and recover the full splitting.
difficulty_reason: The proof first obtains a retraction modulo the braid-group center from the autoequivalence group of the compact Fukaya category. It then identifies the residual finite cyclic obstruction through a cluster exchange graph and the Rabinowitz category, whose action by compactly supported symplectomorphisms is trivial. Recovering the full braid-group splitting requires this categorical comparison and grading control, not merely faithfulness of Dehn twists.
